Within **two dependency hops**, **OrderService** needs these **8 entities**: 3 services, 2 APIs, and 3 databases.

| Hop | Entity | Type | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **OrdersPostgresDatabase** | Database | OrderService stores data in it |
| 1 | **PaymentsAPI** | API | OrderService calls it |
| 1 | **PaymentsService** | Service | Serves PaymentsAPI |
| 1 | **UserService** | Service | OrderService depends on it |
| 2 | **NotificationsAPI** | API | PaymentsService calls it |
| 2 | **NotificationsService** | Service | Serves NotificationsAPI |
| 2 | **PaymentsPostgresDatabase** | Database | PaymentsService stores data in it |
| 2 | **UsersPostgresDatabase** | Database | UserService stores data in it |

Here, an API call and the service serving that API count as the same dependency hop. No configuration keys were returned by this dependency traversal.
